title: LIST CHANGED WHILE STILL IN USE
message:
`List.push` changes `xs` in place, but `xs` is read again afterwards.

126|ownershipConflict xs = ( xs, List.push xs 1 )
                             ^^ `xs` is taken here, and read after the change
                                 ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^ the list is changed in place here

If the list were changed in place, `xs` would see the change when it is read on
line 126.

To change a copy and leave `xs` as it was, copy it there:

126|ownershipConflict xs = ( xs, List.push (List.copy xs) 1 )

This is sharing the checker can see: `xs` is read on line 126, after the change.
